Promotes the development and profitable growth of the commercial banking portfolio by: Responding to inquiries from internal and external sources for the opening of offshore commercial deposit accounts Ensuring the growth in the offshore deposit portfolio by maintaining and deepening the relationship with existing clients as well as by acquiring new ones, all in a manner compliant with Bank procedures and Regulatory requirements. Acting upon qualified prospects, for non borrowing products and services to maximize business development opportunities for sustainable growth; Identifying prospects/referrals from other internal/external networks; Referring customers and prospects to the appropriate Credit Solutions Manager as necessary. Conducting annual reviews as appropriate to ensure the maintenance of profitability and to re-evaluate AML, ATF and Reputational risks. Pursues a business development program within the assigned portfolio of accounts according to Agreed Upon Growth Objectives By Developing strategic sales plans for existing customers, as well as strategies for new customer acquisition; Direct selling of all GTB and non-credit products, and referring credit products as appropriate; Executing on an active call program with customers, prospects and referral sources. Maintaining an appropriate ongoing sales pipeline; Maintaining effective follow-up with existing clients on any unsuccessful opportunities Update client or contact information accurately and in a timely fashion. Monitoring and reviewing customer transactions (for those accounts assigned) from time to time to ensure activity is appropriate for the type of business and in line with expectations, investigating, documenting and making recommendations where exceptions are detected. Assisting in obtaining additional information from customers concerning unusual activity identified on the Account Monitoring Reports/ / LCTR’s/ Daily Significant Transaction Reports etc. Along with the Branch Compliance Officer assisting in the preparation of Suspicious Activity Reports. Reporting any unusual occurrences or fraudulent activity to your Supervisor as soon as you become aware of it in conjunction with the Bank’s Anti-Money Laundering Guidelines. Contribute to Centre Productivity and Service by: Organizing work to maximize productivity Maintaining effective and harmonious working relationships with other branch / centre staff Preparing returns, reports, and correspondence accurately and promptly Maintaining an accurate and complete B/F system Complexity Of Position The incumbent requires a thorough knowledge of the Bank’s and local government’s policies for opening new deposit accounts, due diligence processes and commercial account documentation. Good communication and interpersonal skills are essential to this position. The incumbent must be able to effectively articulate their views both within the Bank and externally in the marketplace. Strong PC skills are necessary, including a working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Lotus notes and other commercial systems and platforms. Functional Competencies Good networking and interpersonal skills Good communication skills (oral and written) Good relationship management skills Good knowledge of Bank’s commercial deposit products and services, and the full GTB suite of products and services. Good sales/closing skills Good knowledge of relationship building and teamwork skills Location(s): Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. review_candidates.description: Onomondo is on a mission to revolutionise global IoT connectivity and we’re looking for an Business Development Representative to help make that happen. We’re here to redefine how connected devices communicate, and we need great people to help us push the boundaries of what’s possible. Our services enable secure authentication, signalling, and messaging for devices using Onomondo SIM cards, across 680+ networks in 180+ countries. Open Doors. Build Pipeline. Shape the Future of Global IoT Connectivity. Based in our Copenhagen HQ, you’ll be the first human connection for the people behind some of the world’s most innovative IoT products. This isn’t about pushing a pitch. It’s about sparking meaningful conversations from scratch, finding the right people, uncovering their challenges, and helping them see how Onomondo can unlock new possibilities for their business. If you thrive on discovery, love learning about how things work, and want to help companies build smarter, more connected products, this is your moment. What You’ll Be Doing Your role as BDR is to generate new sales opportunities by initiating high-quality outbound engagement with target accounts. The role drives top-of-funnel growth, creates early customer connections, and fuels the pipeline for AEs, helping Onomondo scale in key markets. This role doesn’t just build a pipeline; it allows innovators to bring more innovative connected products to market faster. Specifically, your role will consist of the following: Execute targeted outbound outreach via phone, email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels to generate net-new pipeline (≈ 500 activities/week). Identify and engage prospects within our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) across priority verticals and regions. Qualify prospects through discovery to assess business needs, timing, and fit, ensuring opportunities meet handover criteria. Build knowledge in our core verticals (logistics, mobility, etc.) to strengthen outreach relevance and customer understanding. Book meetings with qualified prospects and hand them over to the assigned Account Executive with full context. Maintain CRM hygiene: update lead stages daily, log all outreach activities, and manage tasks in HubSpot. Collaborate with MRAs to refine prospect lists, improve targeting, and share market feedback. Continuously test and adapt messaging for personalization and relevance, based on response data and conversion insights. Participate in weekly pipeline syncs and feedback sessions with AEs, BDR Team Lead, and RevOps. What You Bring Fluent English; you’ll prospect and collaborate in English. Ideally, experience in a BDR/SDR role within complex B2B sales (e.g. SaaS, connectivity, hardware, or tech-enabled services), where you have experience targeting ICP accounts, managing outreach cadences, as well as a proven track record in cold calling and messaging We are equally open to candidates who have built strong communication and resilience in other high-paced, people-facing environments (e.g. hospitality, service industry, or other roles that require consistent interpersonal engagement). Demonstrated consistency, resilience, and drive in high-pressure settings – whether professional or personal (background in competitive sports at a high level is considered a strong plus). Nice to Have Skills: HubSpot proficiency - you’ll be expected to manage your own sequences, track activities, and keep your pipeline data squeaky clean. Familiarity with IoT or connectivity space - helps you speak the customer’s language and spot relevant use cases from day one. Experience with vertical-specific outreach (e.g., logistics, manufacturing, smart devices). Prior experience in a high-growth tech or startup environment, where speed, iteration, and ownership are part of the culture. We believe great outbound talent comes from many backgrounds. If you’re commercially curious, love a good conversation, and want to help businesses solve real problems, we want to hear from you, even if your path looks different. Soft Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; strong listener and question-asker. Ability to build rapport quickly and guide conversations with empathy and structure. Organized, proactive, and resilient, able to navigate rejection and iterate fast. Collaborative mindset with a team-first attitude and a desire to grow. Why join Onomondo? We’re not just building another connectivity layer – we’re reimagining how global IoT connectivity works from the ground up. With customers like Maersk and global use cases across industries, we’re tackling problems that have never been solved before. You will experience: Impact with purpose: Your work will help product builders solve real-world problems, from logistics to health to sustainability, through better connectivity. Clear growth path: Consistently hit 10 SQLs / €6.6K pipeline per month, and we’ll set you up for fast-track promotion to senior BDR as a first step towards other commercial roles. Invested in your growth: Regular coaching, hands-on learning, team challenges, and quarterly off-sites to level up and celebrate wins. Real conversations, real people: We focus on quality, empathy, and relevance in every message, every call, every time. A workspace that’s one-of-a-kind, in both design and energy A team that’s small, sharp, and all-in on shipping meaningful things fast, with room for your voice and fingerprints on what we build. A playful, ambitious culture where people are trusted to do what they do best. Catered fresh lunches, snack heaven, and events that actually bring people together. Our hiring process We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process. That means: We don’t need your picture We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role. We’re fast but thoughtful - our goal is to ensure you feel informed, respected, and excited throughout the journey. Screening call with Victor Kirstein (Inside Sales Manager) (Online, 30 minutes) Role play interview with Victor Kirstein and another person from the sales team (In-Person, 1 hour) Meet with our Co-Founder, Michael Karlsen (In-Person, 30 minutes) Ready to Make an Impact?
